remarks: Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Westport's most convenient locations, 6 Imperial Landing offers the perfect blend of privacy, light-filled living, and effortless luxury. Thoughtfully designed and finished across three levels, this 4-bedroom, 3 full and 1 half bath home features well-proportioned rooms, an open layout, and an abundance of natural light throughout. Expansive windows bring the outdoors in, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere in every space. The heart of the home is a chef's kitchen that flows seamlessly into the main living areas - ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with dream walk-in closets and a newly renovated, spa-like bath designed for comfort and relaxation. The finished lower level adds exceptional versatility, offering a playroom, gym, kitchenette, and an additional bedroom or private office - perfect for today's flexible lifestyle. Set on beautifully landscaped grounds, the property features a waterfall, multiple patios, and a fully fenced backyard, creating a private oasis for relaxing and entertaining. A 3-car garage adds both convenience and functionality. With many recent upgrades throughout, this home is truly move-in ready - simply unpack and enjoy. A rare and special opportunity to experience the full Westport lifestyle, just minutes from the train, restaurants, Longshore, Compo Beach, Saugatuck Center, and downtown.
